_about.summary: Between-census percentile interpolation of per-division SEIFA standing. pct(idx) = within-chamber percentile rank (rankDis/N, 1/N = most disadvantaged) computed on each bracketing census' own geometry, blended by census-night distance, pcti = (1-f)*pct0 + f*pct1. The c0 side is the measured store row (read back, never re-derived); the c1 side is the new concordance lattice. Measured-only elections (2001/2022/2025) carry no pcti. Regenerate: python3 .build/analysis/seat-model/derive-division-seifa-interp.py
